title: Metric
description: A figure an app declares in its manifest, computed by the app's code and read under the reader's rights (doctrine D-052). Boards, the apps' homes and summaries compose metrics; no one writes a query. Its axes are the center's references, so that a filter « project = X » applies to every app's figures at once.

name.description: The app's area, then the figure: « finance.available », « team.absences ».

description.description: How it is computed, in a sentence a person reads beside « Pourquoi ? ».

unit.description: money: in the currency's smallest unit, with its currency. count, days, hours, percent: plain numbers.

better.description: Whether a rise is good news (up), bad news (down), or neither (none).

axes.description: What it can be split or filtered by.
